svg.title: Direct Connect with a Site-to-Site VPN backup
svg.desc: A corporate data center at the top holds a customer gateway device. Two paths lead down from it to one transit gateway in an AWS Region. The primary path is highlighted and runs through AWS Direct Connect and a Direct Connect gateway. The backup path is dashed and runs through the internet and an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. Below the transit gateway are EC2 instances in VPC A and in VPC B, and the transit gateway connects to both VPCs.
